note: Source registry with a license gate. Research of 11 Nov 2026, not legal advice. See docs/knowledge-feeder.md. The code refuses every source whose status is not allowed or metadata_only; nothing in a flag or config can override this file.

sources.title: SAP product documentation (markdown sources on GitHub)
sources.reason: Open-licensed git repositories. Only repos whose GitHub-detected license is CC-BY-4.0, Apache-2.0 or MIT are read; share-alike, unknown or missing licenses are skipped as needs_review.
sources.attribution_text: {title}, {repo_url}, licensed under {license}. Converted to plain text and split into chunks; content otherwise unchanged.

sources.title: SAP samples (GitHub organization SAP-samples)
sources.reason: Same per-repo license rule. Only an explicit allowlist in sources/scope.json is read, never the whole organization.
sources.attribution_text: {title}, {repo_url}, licensed under {license}. Converted to plain text and split into chunks; content otherwise unchanged.

sources.title: SAP Architecture Center
sources.reason: Repository license and whether the rendered site content is covered are not checked.

sources.title: SAP tutorials (SAPDocuments/Tutorials)
sources.reason: License not checked (developers.sap.com shows a tutorial-license tag).

sources.title: SAP News Center feeds (EN, DE, press releases, newsbytes)
sources.reason: Terms of Use for SAP Websites: no automated copying of content. Only title, URL, date, categories and language are stored, never article text. Note: robots.txt of news.sap.com currently disallows unlisted user agents, so the collector refuses the fetch.
sources.attribution_text: Pointer to {url} (SAP News Center). Metadata only, no article text.

sources.title: SAP Community RSS feeds (configured by the user)
sources.reason: Same rule as the News Center: title, URL, date and tags only. Feeds come from sources/community-feeds.json; robots.txt of community.sap.com disallows some feed paths and is honored.
sources.attribution_text: Pointer to {url} (SAP Community). Metadata only, no post text.

sources.title: SAP Help Portal
sources.reason: robots.txt disallows an automated fetch (robots_disallowed) and the Terms of Use prohibit crawlers and AI use.

sources.title: SAP Community pages and undocumented APIs
sources.reason: Page scraping and undocumented APIs are not permitted by the Terms of Use and the SAP API Policy.

sources.title: SAP News Center article pages
sources.reason: Only the feed metadata is used. Article text must not be fetched or stored by software.

sources.title: SAP Notes and Knowledge Base Articles
SAP Business Accelerator Hub (API specifications)
sources.reason: API specs are downloadable per API, but the terms and the SAP API Policy (April 2026) are not checked for software-driven download.
